note: The grass audit's missing species (docs/plant-data/grass-audit.md), in four batches: 'add-first', the twelve of the 'Add first' table, added in 0.9.91, 'europe', the ten of 'Europe and design grasses', added in 0.9.92, 'worth-adding', the twelve of 'Worth adding next', added in 0.9.130, and 'decided', giant miscanthus from 'Decide before adding', added with them. Each row is the record as written, its sources, and where the sources disagree, what was chosen and why. Hoffman's figures come from its catalog listing at https://hoffmannursery.com/plants, read through a browser because the site refuses a plain fetch. RHS hardiness ratings are the RHS's own scale (H4 is -10 to -5 C, H5 -15 to -10, H6 -20 to -15, H7 below -20) and are not USDA zones; a European nursery gives no USDA zone at all, so the zones in the European batch lean on US nurseries. Colours are authored throughout.
